### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[O-Section]: Clearly distinguish between patient-reported symptoms (e.g., "patient reports pain") and provider-interpreted physical exam findings or diagnostic results (e.g., "doctor notes positive straight-leg raise test"). Do not attribute provider interpretations or diagnostic conclusions to the patient.
[A-Section]: Limit statements about exacerbating factors or causal links to those explicitly articulated by the provider. Avoid inferring connections not directly stated in the transcript.
